# RadCrew

> RadCrew is a lean software development agency of three senior engineers building
> full-stack web products, Web3 systems on EVM and Solana, and AI features from
> prototype to production. Contact: code@radcrew.org

This is the full-detail companion to /llms.txt — the same site, expanded with the
complete copy from each section instead of summaries and links.

## Overview

RadCrew ("RadCrew Unveiled") is a small, senior development agency: "We build
what's next." The crew is three senior engineers only — no juniors, no handoffs.
The people you meet are the people who build. They partner with startups and
scale-ups who want velocity without sacrificing quality, on projects ranging from
3-month MVPs to multi-year embedded engagements. The website (https://radcrew.org)
is a single-page site with a built-in FAQ chatbot.

## Services and capabilities

Core capabilities are organized into three areas:

1. **Full-stack product engineering** — from scalable data pipelines to
   bulletproof production systems. Platforms architected to scale elegantly from
   day one: web apps, APIs, dashboards, and integrations. TypeScript-first,
   cloud-ready, built for maintainability.
2. **Web3 on EVM and Solana** — secure smart contract development, complex DeFi
   mechanics, and full-stack dApp architecture, rigorously tested and flawlessly
   executed. Smart contracts, protocol UX, wallets, and indexing, shipping on
   Ethereum and L2s plus Solana when a product needs speed, composability, or
   cross-chain clarity.
3. **AI in the real product** — embedding intelligent capabilities into existing
   stacks, from custom RAG pipelines to fine-tuned autonomous agents, plus
   production AI features. Connecting models to your data, auth, and stack so AI
   ships with the rest of the product, not as a demo bolted on the side.

## How RadCrew works

A four-phase rhythm from first call to production and beyond:

1. **Discover** — map the architecture, define constraints, and build the
   blueprint; align on outcomes and risk, and propose a thin slice to validate
   architecture and UX early.
2. **Build** — elite engineering velocity, transparent sprints, relentless
   precision; short cycles with visible progress, trunk-based flow, reviews, and
   demos.
3. **Ship** — deploy to production, stabilize infrastructure, and hand off clean
   docs; hardening, observability, and care about launch day and the week after.
4. **Partner** — a long-term embedded relationship to scale the product forward;
   stay for a phase-two roadmap or transition cleanly, with knowledge living in
   the repo and runbooks.

## Track record

40+ projects shipped, 12+ happy clients, 5 years building, and a 99.9% uptime SLA.

## Selected work

- **Real Estate Consultant** — a client-facing discovery and advisory experience
  with property search, market context, and guided consultation flows in a
  polished, trustworthy UI. Stack: React, Next.js, product UI.
- **CryptoPets** — a collectible pet experience on-chain with minting, trading,
  and profile flows, built with a bright, approachable UI for mainstream Web3
  onboarding. Stack: React, Web3, NFTs.

Representative problem areas (illustrative of capability, not an exhaustive client
list): multi-chain DeFi analytics, enterprise RAG assistants, Solana trading
experiences, NFT creator tooling, cross-chain bridge/relayer ops dashboards, AI
support copilots, realtime collaboration SaaS, mobile Web3 wallets, ML pipeline
observability, DAO governance portals, and B2B API platforms.

## Technology

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Django, Flask, Python, Rust,

## FAQ

**What size projects do you take on?**
RadCrew partners with startups and scale-ups on projects from 3-month MVPs to
multi-year embedded engagements — quality over quantity.

**Do you work on fixed-price or time-and-materials contracts?**
Both; they recommend the right model based on the project's scope and certainty.

**How quickly can you start?**
Typically within 2 weeks of signing — capacity is kept deliberately limited to
ensure exceptional execution.

**Do you offer post-launch support?**
Yes — the Partner phase is an ongoing embedded relationship, not just a
maintenance contract; they stay and scale with you.

**What makes RadCrew different?**
Senior talent only, no handoffs to juniors — the people you meet are the people
who build, with meticulous execution.
